name: Cat Planet Idle 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Cat Planet Idle is a casual idle game where you place Add and Multiply boosters on orbits to amplify each cat’s score before it spirals into the core planet.Key FeaturesBooster system with Add and Multiply boosters that enhance every passing catMerge and upgrade mechanics to combine identical boosters into stronger onesCat collection with over 10 unique breeds, each with special abilitiesMultiple game modes offering varied challenges and strategiesGame ModesNormal Mode: Classic idle gameplay where you build your booster setupTime Mode: Compete against the clock for the highest scoreMinus Mode: Only Gloomy cats with negative values, making Add boosters essentialTroublemaker Mode: Disruptive cats break booster slots, requiring repairsSuper Combo Mode: Each merge has a chance to reward a free boosterMore modes coming soonPro TipsSpreading boosters across orbits can be more effective than merging too quicklyMultiply boosters perform best on inner orbitsBoosters can be exchanged at any timeYou can join the discussion on Reddit.
